exposure: Nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex cesarean delivery
Hospitals with nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex cesarean delivery rates greater than 23.9%
Tercile of hospitals with the greatest decline in cesarean delivery rates
Participation in California Maternal Quality Care Collaborative (CMQCC)
Participation in California Maternal Quality Care Collaborative (CMQCC) statewide collaborative to support vaginal birth and reduce primary cesarean delivery
outcome: Nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex cesarean delivery rate
cohort: Mothers and neonates in California hospitals participating in the CMQCC collaborative from 2015 to 2017
finding: Participation in a large-scale collaborative to support vaginal birth was associated with reductions in cesarean delivery rates without worsening maternal or neonatal safety outcomes.
mod_finding: A quality improvement program aimed at reducing nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex cesarean delivery rates was successful in doing so without negatively impacting maternal or neonatal safety outcomes.
